state_machine.transition_flow: PLANNED -> RESERVED -> TRANSPORT_COMPLETED -> RAW_PERSISTED -> PARSED -> SCORED -> PIPELINE_COMPLETED
state_machine.enforcement: Strict state transition validation; invalid state jumps raise RuntimeError.

persistence_rules.write_protocol: Atomic write: sibling temp file -> flush -> fsync -> os.replace -> read-back verification
persistence_rules.read_back_verification: SHA-256 and byte-length match between in-memory transport bytes and re-read persisted file
persistence_rules.storage_location: Execution directory outside repo tree (or gitignored scratch directory)
persistence_rules.repo_commit_policy: NEVER_COMMIT_RAW_RESPONSES (artifacts record SHA-256, byte count, redacted path, persistence status)
persistence_rules.secret_scrubbing: API keys, Authorization headers, and auth tokens scrubbed from journal and all telemetry
persistence_rules.memory_parse_bypass: FORBIDDEN (never parse from volatile RAM if persistence or read-back fails)
persistence_rules.tampering_and_truncation: FAIL_CLOSED on hash mismatch or truncated byte stream
